mechanic_1: Hunt: Take Carolina Wren, Brown Anole, or Texas Horned Lizard anywhere. Hawk +1 Population; prey -1 Population.
mechanic_2: Top Predator: No organism in the v1 deck or this expansion may hunt Cooper's Hawk.
extra_info: At 0 Population, prey enters Compost face up. Enter with 1 Population; maximum 3.

mechanic_1: Harvest Leaves: Feed on Milkweed, Frogfruit, Mistflower, Bluebonnet, or Sunflower. Ant +1 Population; plant -1 Population.
mechanic_2: Large Colony: Texas Leafcutting Ant may hold up to 4 Population instead of the usual 3.
extra_info: Workers carry leaves underground to cultivate their food fungus; they do not eat the leaves.

mechanic_1: Displace Fire Ants: Choose Red Imported Fire Ants in the same plot. Pyramid Ant +1 Population; Fire Ants -1 Population.
mechanic_2: Forage: Take Aphids or Springtails in the same plot. Pyramid Ant +1 Population; prey -1 Population.
extra_info: A fast-moving native ant and competitor of imported fire ants. Maximum 3 Population.

mechanic_1: Gather Seeds: Use Sunflower or Bluebonnet in the same plot. Harvester Ant +1 Population; the plant is unchanged.
mechanic_2: Defensive Colony: Assassin Bugs and Parasitoid Wasps cannot hunt Red Harvester Ant.
extra_info: Texas Horned Lizards may hunt this ant. Enter with 1 Population; maximum 3.

mechanic_1: Graze Microbes: Feed on Turkey Tail Fungus or Soil Bacterium. Springtails +1 Population; decomposer -1 Population.
mechanic_2: Nutrient Cycling: After feeding, one plant in your plot gains +1 Population, up to its maximum.
extra_info: Wolf Spiders may hunt Springtails. Enter with 1 Population; maximum 3.

mechanic_1: Hunt Aphids: Take Aphids anywhere. Lady Beetle +1 Population; Aphids -1 Population.
mechanic_2: Ant Protection: Cannot hunt Aphids protected by Red Imported Fire Ants.
extra_info: Adults and larvae both eat aphids. At 0 Population, prey enters Compost face up.

mechanic_1: Ground Hunt: Take Aphids, Lady Beetle, any ant, or Springtails in the same plot. Spider +1 Population; prey -1 Population.
mechanic_2: Ground Predator: Cannot hunt Monarch, Carpenter Bee, or Parasitoid Wasp.
extra_info: Carolina Wren may hunt this spider as if it were an insect. Maximum 3 Population.

mechanic_1: Ant Specialist: Take Fire Ants, Pyramid Ant, Leafcutting Ant, or Harvester Ant anywhere. Lizard +1 Population; prey -1 Population.
mechanic_2: Limited Diet: Texas Horned Lizard cannot hunt other organisms.
extra_info: Cooper's Hawk may hunt this lizard. Enter with 1 Population; maximum 3.
